## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · head `71c89ea29acae22706effdacc5734bf406f1d492` · 2026-10-30T11:37Z

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #28036`. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` match the claim. The change is `@object-ui/app-shell` only, so no contract review is owed. `console/AppContent.tsx`, which seat 4's #27907 holds, is untouched.
- **Mechanism, measured:** `AppContent`'s canonical replace mints a `location.key` on the load entry, so #27454's `key !== 'default'` test read "in-app history" and Save went Back out of the document. `goBack` now reads react-router's own `history.state.idx` at click time. That index is 0 on the load entry, kept by a replace, and one more per push. It goes Back only when the index is above 0; otherwise it goes to the detail page (edit) or the list (new), inside the app. This was chosen over a `location.state` flag because every push already writes the index, so no call site has to mark its navigations.
- **Tests:** the new jsdom `aliasAddressReturn-28036` covers three app-name cells plus a pushed control. Ablating back to the key test turns the three app-name cells red and leaves 6 green, as predicted. The #27454 test's harness moves from `MemoryRouter` to `BrowserRouter` because `MemoryRouter` writes no `idx`; its cells are unchanged. 65/65 pass. The live `record-form-direct-url.spec.ts` now saves on both addresses. The live re-measure has all four card rows in the app with one toast each, the in-app control goes Back to the list, and `test:e2e:live:ci` passes 16/16.
- **Gates (check-runs on the head):** 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 failure, `Live E2E UI` included; `mergeable_state` clean. 34/34 derived gates exit 0 locally. `check-governed-merges --pr 28066`: NOT governed, 313 changed lines.
- **Accepted deviations:** the #27454 test's router harness change is outside the named surface, and is declared.
- **Same family, not changed here:** console `FormPage.tsx`'s cancel uses the same key test, and the layout `PageHeader` uses `history.length > 1`. The seat notes them; neither is reported broken.
- **Landing:** non-governed, all checks green, `mergeable_state` clean ⇒ the seat lands it (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`).
